The BPI delivery notes retain the product name ITPMD Project Hub. BPI text here is a typographic identifier, not a recreated logo. Confirm presenter and presentation date before distribution.
Executive Overview
The Hub connects project updates with TPMO reporting and oversight
Project teams
Maintain workplans, progress and project registers. Prepare weekly reports using the same source data.
TPMO
Review project and program performance. Compare status trends and focus discussion on milestones or items needing action.
Expected value: less repeated reporting and clearer visibility of project performance

Business Background
BPI’s requirements place TPMO at the center of project oversight
Project level
Teams maintain task ownership, schedules, progress and project events.
Program level
Related sub-initiatives contribute to a consolidated schedule and program KPIs.
Portfolio level
TPMO compares project health, milestones and quarterly release commitments.
Requirements baseline
36 functional requirements marked essential, P1 and in scope for the POC.

Current Challenges
Working hypotheses for confirmation with BPI process owners
Schedule consolidation
Separate workplans make project and program dependencies harder to review.
Baseline traceability
Teams need a clear record of rebaselines and the version driving schedule KPIs.
Weekly reporting
Repeated data entry can slow reporting and create inconsistent figures.
Management attention
Aging risks, issues and delayed commitments need consistent visibility.

Project Scope
The BPI requirements define six connected areas
Workplan
Tasks, dependencies, critical path, baselines, earned value and program roll-up.
Project Binder
Risks, issues, dependencies, defects and change requests with aging metrics.
Weekly reporting
Source-data pull, nine qualitative sections and three-page PPT/PDF output.
Portfolio and admin
Dashboards, project profiles, templates, report definitions and standard exports.
Release boundaries, integrations and exclusions: [confirm with BPI]

Key Capabilities
Capabilities grouped by the business decisions they support
Plan and compare
Hierarchical tasks, predecessors, successors, lead/lag, critical path and baseline selection.
Monitor exceptions
Binder ownership, target dates, aging RAG and the most severe risk/issue indicator.
Explain performance
Schedule KPI, weekly highlights and report downloads with required-input checks.
Review the portfolio
Monthly status, weekly RAG, milestone forecasts and quarterly MVP/release commitments.

End-to-End Process
A representative weekly operating cycle
Set up
Create the profile, workplan, owners and baseline.
Maintain
Update progress, actual dates and Binder actions.
Report
Review pulled figures and complete weekly highlights.
Review
Export the report and inspect portfolio exceptions.
Act
Assign follow-up actions and update the next cycle.

History and data quality
